title: PowerToys stops working - Module Keyboard Manager - Remap a shortuc
author: cbrito7912

judgment.rationale: The thread now mixes intermittent text-shortcut failure, a Keyboard Manager engine crash, a KeePass trigger, and text assignments becoming blank. The newest concrete crash is from 0.100.2, while existing dashboard evidence identifies a later Quick Accent interaction fix, so a current-version retest is needed before choosing a fix path.
evidence: The original 0.99.1 report includes a diagnostic ZIP and says restarting PowerToys temporarily restores text shortcuts.
A second reporter posted an engine ABORT log and the original reporter associated a crash with text insertion into KeePass.
The newest reporter reproduced a 0xc0000409 crash on 0.100.2 and found text assignments blank after restarting the service.
The issue is labeled duplicate, but the later crash and assignment-loss evidence is broader than the original intermittent shortcut symptom.
judgment.recommended_action: Request one current-stable reproduction and a fresh post-crash report before consolidating the issue or designing a fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The public evidence does not yet separate an already-handled cross-module key-state failure from a remaining Keyboard Manager crash or persisted-assignment defect.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager text shortcuts intermittently stop or crash, and one 0.100.2 report says saved text assignments became blank after the service restarted.
known_information: Restarting or toggling Keyboard Manager restores operation temporarily.
The latest concrete crash evidence is from 0.100.2.
The issue has a duplicate label but remains open.
inferences: More than one failure mode may be represented in the thread.
A current post-crash report is decision-changing.
issue_context.analysis: A new design would be speculative until a current run establishes whether the crash and assignment loss remain and captures the responsible module state.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

information_gaps.information: Whether the failure persists on the current stable PowerToys release.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether newer Keyboard Manager and cross-module fixes already handled it.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest one affected text shortcut on current stable.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic report immediately after any remaining crash.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is needed to distinguish engine failure from settings persistence.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After reproducing, submit /bugreport and state whether Quick Accent was enabled.

actions.label: Request current Keyboard Manager crash evidence
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body:
Thanks for the detailed crash and assignment-loss reports. Please retest one affected text-insertion shortcut on the current stable PowerToys release and provide:
1. Whether Keyboard Manager still stops or crashes, whether Quick Accent was enabled, and whether reopening and saving the mapping changes the result.
2. If it still crashes, reproduce once and submit a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward.
Please do not post private replacement text.
